description:
## Why This Exists

store/group_cache.rs::GroupMetadataCache::insert() evicts the oldest entry by calling entries.iter().min_by_key(|(_, e)| e.inserted_at) which is O(n). With MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES=10_000, each insertion at capacity requires a full scan.

An LRU structure (e.g. linked-hashmap) or an indexed priority queue would give O(log n) eviction.

## Acceptance Criteria

Replace the O(n) min scan with an O(log n) alternative. The lru crate provides LruCache<K,V> as a drop-in.
title: Rust idiom: GroupMetadataCache uses HashMap with O(n) oldest-entry eviction
